subject: High School Project Community Engagement Plan
overview: The subcommittee met to draft its community engagement and communications strategy for the high school building project, focusing on website design, public surveys, and outreach initiatives. The subcommittee voted to recommend the resulting draft plan to the full High School Building Committee.

items.title: Website Draft and Strategy
items.summary: Tom Dalton presented plans for the building project website at buildingmhs.org, and the subcommittee discussed featuring meeting logs, public documents, and a community questionnaire.

items.title: Near-Range Community Engagement Opportunities
items.summary: The subcommittee discussed engagement ideas during the project's eligibility phase, including school tours, outreach to other municipal boards, student-led video projects, and presence at summer community events.

items.title: Educational Profile Questions
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed the community outreach, facility consolidation, and funding questions required for the MSBA educational profile.

items.title: Plan Recommendation and Role Assignments
items.summary: Members volunteered for specific communication and research tasks, and the subcommittee voted to recommend the draft communications and engagement plan to the full High School Building Committee.
